rv.q: This really is a lush and vibrant "South Pacific," a big night out on a scale you can't still see many places in America, especially when it does such vocal justice to this great score.
Treat yourself and people you love to this timeless classic.

This South Pacific is a richly imagined, beautifully performed revival that captures the sweep, humor, and emotional punch of the Rodgers and Hammerstein defining musical while giving it a revitalized, contemporary pulse.
Paramount’s South Pacific is a journey well worth taking.
It’s all in good fun and what makes Paramount Theatre’s “South Pacific” an enchanting evening out for the whole family.
The lush scenery, colorful costumes, rich orchestral music and enchanting melodies sufficiently capture the magic and mystery of paradise.
In this enjoyable, lovely, theme-driven production, theatergoers will either meet a new show from Broadway’s Golden Era, or greet an old friend that they’ve come to love over the years.

While each delivered strong individual performances, their on-stage chemistry as two people falling in love fell short, lacking the dynamic connection in their scenes together and never reaching the sexy, electric, and natural romantic feel Rodgers & Hammerstein envisioned.
"South Pacific" is one of the best of Rodgers & Hammerstein!
By the final curtain, this South Pacific stands as one of the most visually sumptuous and productions to grace the Paramount stage in recent years.

cn.t: Critics praise this lush, visually stunning revival of the Rodgers and Hammerstein classic, highlighting its beautiful direction, exceptional singing, and emotionally resonant performances that bring timeless romance and social themes to vibrant life.
